description: A skill group for structured development workflow with TDD principles and feature-module classification

evals.prompt: 开始处理这个任务：修改用户登录功能，需要修改 user.ts 和 auth.ts 文件
evals.expected_output: 应该触发 init-workflow-context skill，识别功能模块（user-module），检查模块目录结构，按模块加载记忆

assertions.name: identifies_function_module
assertions.description: 检查是否正确识别功能模块

assertions.name: checks_module_directory
assertions.description: 检查是否检查模块目录结构

assertions.name: loads_module_memory
assertions.description: 检查是否按模块加载记忆

evals.prompt: 帮我修改一下 config.ts 文件，添加一个 getEnvValue 函数来获取环境变量
evals.expected_output: 应该识别 config-module，进行低难度评分，制定TDD测试计划，使用tracer-bullet拆分issues，保存到 modules/config-module/issues/low/

assertions.name: identifies_config_module
assertions.description: 检查是否识别 config-module

assertions.name: performs_complexity_score
assertions.description: 检查是否进行复杂度评分

assertions.name: plans_tdd_test
assertions.description: 检查是否制定TDD测试计划

assertions.name: uses_tracer_bullet
assertions.description: 检查是否使用tracer-bullet方法

assertions.name: saves_to_module_directory
assertions.description: 检查是否保存到模块目录

evals.prompt: 需要重构用户模块的认证流程，涉及 user.ts, auth.ts, session.ts, token.ts 四个文件，需要改变现有的架构设计
evals.expected_output: 应该识别 user-module/auth-module，高难度评分，拆分子需求，创建需求文档和单元测试计划，保存到 modules/user-module/requirements/high/，等待用户确认

assertions.name: identifies_module
assertions.description: 检查是否识别功能模块

assertions.name: identifies_high_difficulty
assertions.description: 检查是否识别为高难度

assertions.name: requires_unit_test
assertions.description: 检查是否要求单元测试

assertions.name: creates_test_plan_in_module
assertions.description: 检查是否在模块内创建测试计划

assertions.name: saves_to_module_high
assertions.description: 检查是否保存到模块高难度目录

assertions.name: asks_user_confirmation
assertions.description: 检查是否请求用户确认

evals.prompt: 按照 coding-principles skill 的要求，修改 login.ts 文件添加错误处理
evals.expected_output: 应该展示4条编码原则的应用，包括TDD循环

assertions.name: shows_think_before_coding
assertions.description: 检查是否展示规则1

assertions.name: shows_simplicity_first
assertions.description: 检查是否展示规则2

assertions.name: shows_surgical_changes
assertions.description: 检查是否展示规则3

assertions.name: shows_goal_driven
assertions.description: 检查是否展示规则4

assertions.name: shows_tdd_cycle
assertions.description: 检查是否展示TDD循环

evals.prompt: 任务已完成，请总结并更新 memory。我们完成了用户模块的认证重构，单元测试覆盖率 85%，修改了 user.ts 和 auth.ts
evals.expected_output: 应该识别 user-module，按模块分类更新 issues 和 requirements 状态，更新模块记忆，按模块分类归档

assertions.name: identifies_module
assertions.description: 检查是否识别功能模块

assertions.name: updates_module_issues
assertions.description: 检查是否按模块更新issues

assertions.name: updates_module_requirements
assertions.description: 检查是否按模块更新需求

assertions.name: updates_module_memory
assertions.description: 检查是否更新模块记忆

assertions.name: archives_by_module
assertions.description: 检查是否按模块归档

evals.prompt: 需要实现批量导入用户功能，涉及 user.ts（用户处理）和 import.ts（导入逻辑）两个模块
evals.expected_output: 应该识别多个模块（user-module 和 import-module），拆分 issues 时保存到各自模块目录

assertions.name: identifies_multiple_modules
assertions.description: 检查是否识别多个模块

assertions.name: saves_to_respective_modules
assertions.description: 检查是否保存到各自模块目录

assertions.name: classifies_by_difficulty_within_module
assertions.description: 检查是否在模块内按难度分类
